description: This file defines the BlockSettings class, a Drupal migration process plugin that configures block settings during migration. It is deprecated and handles various block configuration transformations based on plugin type.

classes.name: BlockSettings
classes.description: A deprecated Drupal migration process plugin class that sets block configuration during migration, based on block type and old settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the block manager service, with deprecation warnings if not provided.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms input data into block configuration settings based on block type and old settings.
